units.rawText: My first meeting with Professor? Ugh... is this something we really need to discuss?
units.displayText: My first meeting with Professor? Ugh... is this something we really need to discuss?

spans.text: My first meeting with Professor? Ugh... is this something we really need to discuss?

units.rawText: If you won't speak, then I'll have to consult the database instead.
units.displayText: If you won't speak, then I'll have to consult the database instead.

spans.text: If you won't speak, then I'll have to consult the database instead.

units.rawText: Ah... Ugh... Fine, I'll talk. I found myself in a Null Area after I woke up... and I wandered about there with no purpose, eventually turning to a Sanctifier for help...
units.displayText: Ah... Ugh... Fine, I'll talk. I found myself in a Null Area after I woke up... and I wandered about there with no purpose, eventually turning to a Sanctifier for help...

spans.text: Ah... Ugh... Fine, I'll talk. I found myself in a Null Area after I woke up... and I wandered about there with no purpose, eventually turning to a Sanctifier for help...

units.rawText: And you know how it ends—they saw me as an Irregular Agent and started hunting me. I even lost my shoes while running... Then, you and your team found me, though I probably looked like absolute crap when we first met.

units.rawText: Pfft, now I remember... The report did mention finding a child Doll with no shoes, messy clothes, and tear streaks near their eyes.
units.displayText: Pfft, now I remember... The report did mention finding a child Doll with no shoes, messy clothes, and tear streaks near their eyes.

spans.text: Pfft, now I remember... The report did mention finding a child Doll with no shoes, messy clothes, and tear streaks near their eyes.

units.rawText: My clothes weren't messy! I made sure every button on my shirt was done up! And I'm not a child!
units.displayText: My clothes weren't messy! I made sure every button on my shirt was done up! And I'm not a child!

spans.text: My clothes weren't messy! I made sure every button on my shirt was done up! And I'm not a child!

units.rawText: A-Anyway, I appreciate you and the Exiles finding me, Professor... But calling me a child? That's too much! I expect compensation!
units.displayText: A-Anyway, I appreciate you and the Exiles finding me, Professor... But calling me a child? That's too much! I expect compensation!

spans.text: A-Anyway, I appreciate you and the Exiles finding me, Professor... But calling me a child? That's too much! I expect compensation!

units.rawText: Heh, my phrasing was awful, I agree. Though you may be short, you've contributed more energy than we could have ever expected during the early days of constructing the Oasis... So, Max, what would you like for compensation?

spans.text: Heh, my phrasing was awful, I agree. Though you may be short, you've contributed more energy than we could have ever expected during the early days of constructing the Oasis... So, Max, what would you like for compensation?

units.rawText: Compensation, huh... Well, well well~ Once we leave the Cloud, I demand that you accompany me to conduct those electromagnetism experiments I've been putting off for far too long. And you must spill the tea about your fellow researchers! That's the deal!
